_documentation_authority.scope: Original payload retained as provenance; current execution order, task status, models and gates are owned by the canonical pair.

feature: UX governance for Discipulado IEADPE web app
global_constraints: User-facing copy uses pt-BR; identifiers, code, specifications, and technical documentation use English.
Design tokens are defined exactly once in lib/ui/app_theme.dart. Feature tasks consume primitives and never re-theme controls.
Body text is at least 16 logical pixels with a consistent 4/8 spacing scale and 44x44 minimum touch targets.
Text contrast is at least 4.5 to 1 and control boundary and focus indication at least 3 to 1 in light and dark modes.
Each touches entry is an exact path exclusively owned by that task. Tasks with overlapping touches never share a wave.
No expected_red field. No offline write queue, no persistent sensitive browser cache, no false success messages.
Do not deploy, push, import legacy data, or send messages. No legal-compliance claim.

tasks.title: Audit theme tokens and shared primitives
tasks.summary: Consolidate the visual language into theme tokens and responsive primitives. Sole owner of the listed lib/ui files in this plan.
acceptance: Primary #002060, secondary #00A3E0, and accent #E31B23 ship in light and dark surfaces with measured contrast proof for every semantic text and focus token in both modes.
Layouts reflow at 360, 768, and 1440 widths with 200 percent text scaling and no page-wide horizontal scroll; tables scroll only inside a labeled region when content cannot reflow.
AsyncContent distinguishes loading, empty dataset, empty search, error with retry, forbidden, and not-found; forms focus the first invalid field and announce outcomes.
Reduced-motion removes positional animation and overshoot; translucent chrome has an opaque fallback. No feature file outside touches is modified.

tasks.title: Apply accessible scoped navigation and lists
tasks.summary: Wire routes, scope handling, and feature lists through the audited primitives. Sole owner of the router and listed feature pages in this plan.
acceptance: Deep links, hard refresh, and back and forward restore validated scope, search text, and filters; pagination cursor stays session-local and resets on reload or scope change.

Every action works by keyboard with visible focus, dialog focus trap, Escape cancel, and focus restoration; attendance exposes Presente, Ausente, Justificado, and Nao marcado as text plus semantics, never color alone.
WhatsApp links use normalized digits only with an accessible copy-phone fallback and a labeled disabled state when no phone exists; no religious or student data is prefilled.
No lib/ui token file from task 1 is modified in this task.

tasks.title: Record privacy andWays of working governance
tasks.summary: Publish LGPD handling notes, the accessibility sheet, and the agile backlog contract. Sole owner of the governance docs in this plan.
acceptance: docs/lgpd-notes.md states data minimization, no PII in logs, URLs, or analytics, noindex metadata, authenticated-only access, and that retention and backup belong to deployment administration with no invented schedule.
docs/accessibility-sheet.md records the manual matrix of widths, text scaling, keyboard-only flow, screen-reader names and outcomes, reduced motion, and contrast readings.
docs/backlog-contract.md defines INVEST slicing, DoR versus DoD, and plan.json wave ordering by depends_on with exclusive touches per task.
No code file from tasks 1-2 is modified in this task.
